# Auto Cards

> Auto Cards turns uploaded documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text, Markdown)
> into gamified, spaced-repetition flashcard decks. Upload a slide deck, a
> chapter or a set of notes and get a study-ready deck in seconds — web and
> mobile share the same generation, scoring and scheduling logic.

## Product

- Home: https://autocards.study/
- Live demo (no account required): https://autocards.study/demo
- Sign up: https://autocards.study/sign-up

- PDF to flashcards: https://autocards.study/pdf-to-flashcards

- Word to flashcards: https://autocards.study/word-to-flashcards
- Lecture notes to flashcards: https://autocards.study/lecture-notes-to-flashcards

## Notes for automated readers

- Generation is model-assisted: uploaded content is sent to an LLM to produce
  cards, then normalized and repaired client-side so malformed output never
  reaches the deck as broken cards.
- Supported uploads are PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), plain text and
  Markdown.
- Scanned or image-only PDFs (no text layer) are rejected before generation —
  there is no OCR step.
- Everything under /app requires a signed-in account and is not useful to
  crawl; see https://autocards.study/robots.txt.
- The full list of indexable URLs is at https://autocards.study/sitemap.xml.
